bio.headline: The Journey
bio.subheadline: From grassroots campus tech evangelist to high-velocity Web3 ecosystem builder, operator, and regional community manager.
bio.paragraph1: Mark Chinedum Daniel, known in the global ecosystem as Drapevangelist, operates at the vital intersection of decentralized protocol adoption, technical community infrastructure, and regional builder empowerment across Africa.
bio.paragraph2: His track record spans foundational leadership at Blockchain Uniport, organizing university hackathon cohorts, onboarding 70+ student developers from scratch into smart contract tooling, and anchoring verified physical summits for premier global ecosystems including Base, Movement Labs, ETHNigeria, and Rujira.
bio.paragraph3: Beyond operations, Daniel channels his passion as a recording artist and creative technologist—translating complex protocol architectures into cultural narratives that resonate from university halls in Port Harcourt to global decentralized governance tables.
